baseDomain.description: A DNS name, or empty for a host that publishes nothing. Pattern-constrained because modules/proxy/nginx.nix interpolates this into server_name, into an ACME certificate name, and into an error_page redirect target: an unconstrained string here is an nginx directive the settings API can write. Mirrors modules/lib/hostnames.nix's dnsName, which enforces the same thing at evaluation.

items.description: One network for nginx's `allow` directive. Pattern-constrained because modules/proxy/nginx.nix interpolates each entry into `allow ${net};` at the head of a lan app's `location /`, BEFORE the `deny all;` and the auth_request block -- an unconstrained string here closes the location and publishes the app with forward-auth absent. Mirrors modules/lib/hostnames.nix's networkLiteral, which enforces the same thing at evaluation.

listenAddress.description: A loopback address literal, and nothing else. Tighter than the NixOS option's own type on purpose: modules/core/daemon.nix's A5 assertion refuses a non-loopback address at evaluation, but by then the value is already in settings.json and the operator's next apply fails. Refusing it here refuses the WRITE. It is also the injection boundary -- this value is interpolated into proxy_pass, and a real nginx accepted, and served, the directive smuggled through an unconstrained string here.

subdomain.description: A DNS label, non-empty. Same reasoning as proxy.baseDomain above; mirrors modules/lib/hostnames.nix's dnsLabel.

apps.description: Per-app settings, keyed by catalog app name. Deep per-app validation is STILL deferred -- every key other than auth.bypassPaths below is accepted unvalidated, which is what the two additionalProperties: true nodes say. What is no longer deferred is the one value under here that lands inside a generated directive.

items.description: A location prefix served without forward-auth. Pattern-constrained because modules/proxy/nginx.nix interpolates it as the `location ${path} {` NAME and modules/proxy/authelia.nix wraps it in the access_control regex `^${path}.*$` -- an unconstrained string here either adds an ungated sibling location to a catalog app or widens the Authelia bypass rule to the whole vhost. Mirrors modules/lib/hostnames.nix's locationPath, which enforces the same thing at evaluation.
